prompt.en: How many Canadians served in the First World War, out of a population of eight million?
prompt.fr: Combien de Canadiens ont servi durant la Première Guerre mondiale, sur une population de huit millions d'habitants?

options.en: More than 600,000, most of them volunteers.
options.fr: Plus de 600 000, en majorité des volontaires.

explanation.en: Over 600,000 Canadians wore the uniform between 1914 and 1918, most of them by choice, from a country of only eight million people. By the end, 60,000 were dead and 170,000 hurt.
explanation.fr: Plus de 600 000 Canadiens ont porté l'uniforme entre 1914 et 1918, la plupart par choix, dans un pays de seulement huit millions d'habitants. À la fin, 60 000 étaient morts et 170 000 blessés.

source.quote: More than 600,000 Canadians served in the war, most of them volunteers, out of a total population of eight million.

verification.evidence: More than 600,000 Canadians served in the war, most of them volunteers, out of a total population of eight million. … In total 60,000 Canadians were killed and 170,000 wounded.
